title: Labour-cost analysis for "Replication, not fabrication: documentation is the rate-limiting step for democratized self-driving labs"
description: Script and outputs behind Figure 1 and Tables 3-4 of the Perspective. labor_cost_analysis.py derives each contributed project's break-even wage (the loaded hourly rate at which build labour equals the bill of materials), labour shares and a rate-sensitivity sweep, using only the self-reported cost-to-reproduce and time-to-reproduce figures in the paper's Table 1. Outputs: table1-derived.csv, sensitivity.csv, fig1-labour-vs-bom.png.
